title: Historically versioned calendar-adjustment infrastructure for MENA economic data

fields.name: date
fields.description: Gregorian calendar date

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: ISO-like country identifier used by the Lab

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country name

fields.name: weekday
fields.description: Weekday index

fields.name: working_day
fields.description: Whether the date is a normal working day under the historically applicable regime

fields.name: weekend_regime
fields.description: Historically applicable weekend / working-week regime

fields.name: ramadan
fields.description: Date falls within Ramadan

fields.name: ramadan_day
fields.description: Ramadan day index where applicable

fields.name: eid_fitr
fields.description: Date falls within the coded Eid al-Fitr interval

fields.name: eid_adha
fields.description: Date falls within the coded Eid al-Adha interval

fields.name: hajj_period
fields.description: Date falls within the coded Hajj interval where economically relevant

fields.name: national_holiday
fields.description: Country-specific national/public holiday flag

fields.name: school_holiday
fields.description: School holiday flag when a verified historical series is available

fields.name: working_hours_regime
fields.description: Historically applicable working-hours regime

fields.name: ramadan_work_hours
fields.description: Special Ramadan working-hours regime flag

fields.name: holiday_overlap
fields.description: Count of coded holiday/calendar regimes overlapping the date

fields.name: gregorian_month
fields.description: Gregorian month

fields.name: hijri_month
fields.description: Hijri month where verified conversion is available

fields.name: fraction_ramadan_month
fields.description: Monthly aggregate: fraction of Gregorian month falling in Ramadan

fields.name: fraction_working_days_month
fields.description: Monthly aggregate: share of calendar days coded as working days

fields.name: regime_source
fields.description: Source supporting the applicable historical calendar regime

fields.name: retrieval_date
fields.description: Date the Lab retrieved/verified the source

fields.name: validation_state
fields.description: Lab validation state

claim_boundary: This schema defines the intended country-date contract. It does not imply complete 1990-2050 coverage. Country-date rows enter the release only after the relevant holiday, working-week and regime sources are verified.
